scope: One production-status update notice only; existing native wording and all farming source values are preserved. No fluent review claimed.

entries.source: Production plans keep unmarked plants and housing as proposed, matching your design.

drafts.zu: Izinhlelo zokukhiqiza zigcina izitshalo nezindlu zezilwane ezingaphawuliwe njengezihleliwe, ngokuhambisana nomklamo wakho.
drafts.st: Meralo ya tlhahiso e boloka dimela le meaho ya diphoofolo e sa tshwauwang e le tse rerilweng, ho latela moralo wa hao.
drafts.ts: Mapulani ya vuhumelerisi ya hlayisa swimilana ni tindlu ta swifuwo leswi nga funghiwang swi ri leswi kunguhatiweke, ku landzela pulani ya wena.
drafts.ve: Pulane dza mveledziso dzi vhea zwimela na zwifhaṱo zwa zwifuwo zwi sa athu u swaiwa sa zwo dzudzanywaho, u tevhedza pulane yaṋu.
